issues: Role buttons (family-role-trusted/limited/guest) use 3-column grid that crops the 'Trusted adult' label on narrow viewports — label wraps but icon+text stay legible. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: ProfileIn.access_code has no maximum length and isn't normalised — two profiles with the SAME access code can coexist; _verify_access returns the FIRST match. With multiple roles this means an attacker who guesses one code maps to whichever profile was added first (probably owner). Recommend enforcing uniqueness of access codes across all profiles for a device at /profiles/add.

/profiles/add does not block reusing the device-level recovery_code or wipe_code as a profile access_code — a limited member could be created with access_code = the recovery code, giving them inadvertent recovery powers if the family later unlocks via that code. Validate access_code != recovery_code and != wipe_code at add time.

list_profiles is awaited inside add_profile and remove_profile to build the response, which works but couples HTTP layer details (returns FastAPI Response). Cleaner: have list_profiles return just the list and have routes wrap it — easier to test and reuse.

_send_alert_email loads RESEND_API_KEY at every call via os.environ.get(...). Fine, but the import `import resend` happens unconditionally — if the resend package is ever missing in a slim build, the module fails to import. Wrap in try/except at import time OR gate with importlib so the file still loads with email dormant.

Setup endpoint silently lowercases/strips backup_email and recovery_email but does not validate the email format. A malformed email could be saved and then attempted as a Resend `to` address when the key is added. Recommend a light regex validation or pydantic EmailStr to avoid future Resend 4xx errors.

FamilyManager uses window.prompt() for the remove-recovery code, which (a) shows the code in plain text and (b) is inconsistent with the in-app add form. Replace with the same in-app form/modal as Add for a consistent stealth experience.

SetupWizard secret-triggers step grew to 4 fields (phrase/pattern/recovery_email/backup_email) — fine on tall phones but on 390x844 the Continue button can be off-screen until scroll. Consider a scrollable container or split into two sub-steps.
